about: The painted backdrop beyond the walkable area of S2 (canal, the canal wharves, scan u 20500-29050) (map/BUILDING.md: painting, not models). tools/backdrop.mjs restyles each panel from the scroll strip that lies past that edge (scan rect u0,v0,u1,v1) with prompts/backdrop_panel.txt + the panel's content prompt (prompts/backdrop_canal_<side>.txt): seen at eye level on plain white, which ship keys out with clean edges; it measures the painted horizon, and web/src/backdrop.js stands the panel on the ring (angles from the section's centre (216.44, 13.08): 0 = east, 90 = north, 180 = west) at its true aspect with that horizon at eye level, its foot in ground mist. Everything outside the painted area is veiled in mist (the scroll's blank silk). West is S3 (the Rainbow Bridge, rainbow_bridge) and east is S1 (the countryside), both being built in round 2: each panel stands in whenever that neighbour isn't loaded and drops when it is. North: the silk's top edge cuts S2's top-row roofs, the far street and the willow crowns; nothing further is painted above them, so mist only. South (below the silk's bottom edge): the river runs off the silk's edge (the south bank exists only in the far west), so mist only. The ring's radius is 115 m, not the 70 m of the shorter sections: S2's painted area reaches 76 m from its centre (the ne corner), so a 70 m circle would cut through its east and west ends.

panels.why: S3 (the Rainbow Bridge, rainbow_bridge, u 15500-20500) lies past the west seam and is being built in round 2: the whole of its strip, as S4b's east panel took it from the other end. Nearest to S2 (u 20500-18800): the bridge's north-foot tavern and handcart on the right (north), the long open-fronted building and the boat moored along the south bank on the left, the big boat lowering its mast at the arch and the cabin boat under it, and the bridge itself with its crowd; beyond it the far-bank halls and moored boats (north) and 十千脚店 with its 彩楼欢门 and riverside hall (south), the sweep boat and the towed boat at the far end. From the section's centre (216.44, 13.08) the west seam spans 165.9 deg (nw 147.06/30.54) to 197.4 deg (sw 160.85/-4.39): the panel is centred on 181.7 and 34 wide (the seam's 31.6 plus 1.2 each side).
panels.picked: 2026-10-12, draw 1 (the content prompt as it is now), two candidates, both read beside the strip (gen/sections/canal/backdrop/review_west.jpg). Picked 0: ground strip 0.0273 of the width, near-white 5.9%, raw rows 291-629 of 733. It holds the strip's things in order, nearest on the right: the bridge-foot sheds and tavern on posts, a moored passenger boat, the lashed-timber arch with its crowded deck, X-topped poles at both ends and parasols, the big boat with its mast being lowered on the near side of the arch, the cabin boat in the arch's shadow and a skiff; beyond on the left the towering openwork pole scaffold over the tavern gate, its two-storey hall with the balcony, the crowd on the road, and farthest a masted boat with its stays and the trackers in a file on the bank. Willows bare pollards. Rejected 1: ground strip 0.0313 and near-white 10.2% (its bare crowns frost at night), and at its far left a mast carrying a white triangular shape that reads as a sail (the prompt says no sails; the scroll's towed boat has none).

panels.why: S1 (the countryside, countryside, u 29050-37610) lies past the east seam and is being built in round 2: its west half, what a walker at S2's east end sees first: the village stall with its thatched roof and the water buffalo lying before it, the vegetable field with its young bare trees, the tiled farmhouse with its veranda, the travellers on donkeys and the runaway horse, the thatched hut behind wattle fences under the huge leaning willow, the willow-decked sedan chair of the tomb-sweeping party, and the great willows of the dyke (u 29050-33500; the farmsteads beyond, u 33400-35000, start at its far end). From the section's centre the east seam spans -19.0 deg (se 267.21/-4.39) to 13.3 deg (ne 290.62/30.54): the panel is centred on -2.9 and 34 wide.
panels.picked: 2026-10-12, draw 1 (the content prompt as it is now), two candidates, both read beside the strip (gen/sections/canal/backdrop/review_east.jpg). Picked 1: ground strip 0.0195 of the width, near-white 4.6%, raw rows 271-624 of 731. Nearest on the left the thatched village stall with the water buffalo lying before it and the ox, the small thatched shed and the pollard willows over the stall; then the tiled farmhouse with its board-walled wing and the young bare trees; the travellers on donkeys and the bolting horse; the huge willow leaning over the thatched hut and its open shed; the tomb-sweeping party with the closed sedan chair whose roof carries a spray of willow twigs (as painted: 杨柳杂花装簇轿顶), a rider and porters; the great pollard willows of the dyke at the right end. Its willows are bare brown fans. Rejected 0: ground strip 0.0156 (better), but near-white 10.0% (the leaning willow's crown is a dense pale-green mass that frosts white at night) and its sedan chair has no willow spray on its roof.
